svg.data-dimensions-in: 4.33 x 3.66 x 2.84 (L x W x H, datasheet)
svg.data-accessories: two pluggable terminal plugs (power and relay), console cable
svg.data-surge-protection: differential mode 2 kV, common mode 6 kV
svg.data-optics-sfp: vendor optics listed under AurCore Accessories - AOM01M-S550 (1G, multimode, 550 m) and AOM01S-K10 (1G, single-mode, 10 km); the datasheet states no compatibility list or third-party policy
svg.data-layer: L2+ (static routing, ERPS ring recovery 20 ms or less)
svg.data-interfaces: console, Telnet, SSH, SNMP v1/v2c/v3, web, ACC/ACN cloud
